description: Controls the whole Rack patch over OSC: any parameter, cable or module can be set, added or removed from an outside client, and the patch is served as an OSCQuery namespace over HTTP
notes: there is nothing to click on this panel; the module carries no knob and no jack, and everything it does arrives as an OSC message from somewhere else
the messages it answers are /param/set, /param/get, /param/watch, /cable/add, /cable/remove, /module/add, /module/remove, /state/dump, /state/watch, /registry/dump and /ping
an address may be sent with a leading /vcv, which the module strips before matching, so a client that speaks through osc-bridge and one that speaks to it directly both work
the display reads out the port OSC messages arrive on, the address and port replies go to, the OSCQuery port and a running count of messages taken
the green lamp flashes on each message received and the yellow one on each message sent
replies are sent to 127.0.0.1 and the address cannot be changed from the panel or the menu; it is saved with the patch and can only be altered by editing the patch file
menu: Listen port: 7770, 8000, 9000, 57120 — chooses the UDP port the module takes OSC messages on, and restarts the server on the new one
Reply port: 7771, 8001, 9001, 57121 — chooses the UDP port replies and change notifications are sent to
Echo /param/value on set — sends a /param/value message back after every /param/set, which is on when the module is placed
Enable OSCQuery — serves the patch as an OSCQuery namespace over HTTP, which is on when the module is placed
OSCQuery port: 7772, 8080, 9000, 5678 — chooses the HTTP port the OSCQuery namespace is served on
Restart OSC server — binds the ports again and starts the server from scratch
